memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Nu remains an Avoid while the next earnings and credit tests are unresolved. The latest completed US close was 15.66 dollars on 6 October, compared with the frozen 14.30-dollar anchor. That is a 9.51% opportunity cost for staying out, not a loss on an executed short. We cannot yet say whether the original valuation caution was right or wrong for its stated reason. The November forecasts still require standalone revenue and diluted EPS to be tested against the frozen consensus, alongside delinquency, credit cost and provisioning. A lower, properly scoped Group cost of equity could also weaken the call. Keep the no-entry stance under review, retain the effective decision-time conviction of 47 as the historical reference, and obtain the primary Q3 filing before changing the conclusion. No new numerical conviction or benchmark-relative performance claim is supported today.
